flow_name: Multi-Organization Selection & Cost Centers (Party ID) Inspection

automation_boundary.automated_scope: Authenticated state without default org -> View 'Select a Organization to continue' -> Expand 'N COST CENTERS (PARTY IDS)' drawer -> Verify Cost Centers (Party IDs) -> Select target organization -> Land on Dashboard 360.
automation_boundary.external_boundary: Upstream CRM organization hierarchy and Party ID relationships are managed in Netcracker BSS.

canonical_steps.action: Verify the 'Select a Organization to continue' screen is displayed after authentication
canonical_steps.expected_result: The screen displays cards for all organizations linked to the user profile with active status badges

canonical_steps.action: Click the 'COST CENTERS (PARTY IDS)' link on an organization card
canonical_steps.expected_result: The Cost Centers drawer opens displaying the associated Party IDs and account names

canonical_steps.action: Verify the Party ID list rendered within the drawer
canonical_steps.expected_result: Party IDs and cost center names match the company entity registration

canonical_steps.action: Click the Organization card to set the active organizational context
canonical_steps.expected_result: The organization is selected and the user navigates to the authenticated Dashboard 360
